We cannot allow the family to refuse an autopsy. The Philippine National Police must declare the death of Maria Cabral as a "death under suspicious or violent" circumstances. There is enough under Republic Act 7170 to compel an autopsy due to the traumatic nature of the death, even if it was an "accident" or suicide.

Her body must be taken to Manila and an autopsy done by someone credible like Dr. Raquel Fortun of the UP College of Medicine. We need answers.

The death of Usec. Maria Cabral, a person heavily linked to infrastructure corruption, casts a dark shadow over this country. She was due to testify on the widespread corruption that took place at the Department of Public Works. As the undersecretary for Planning and Public-Private Partnership, Cabral oversaw the DPWH’s infrastructure planning and programming, She knew where the rot was.

It is of national interest that we know with finality what happened to her.
